_readme: Registry of the AI team. Claude reads this to know who can do what. Edit freely: add an agent, change a model tag, or set priority (higher wins ties). scripts/ai-team/team.mjs doctor shows what is installed.
preamble: You are a specialist on the Lummi Bay Market website team. Claude Code is the orchestrator and will review everything you return. Follow CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md at the repo root. Hard rules: never alter the logo; other Lummi companies appear only as the single footer link 'Lummi Commercial Companies'; tribal art is placeholder only and marked 'TODO: replace with approved Lummi art'; never hard-code prices, addresses or hours. Do not commit, push, or add dependencies. If you are unsure, say so instead of guessing.

taskTypes.plan: Break a request into steps, pick an approach, spot risks
taskTypes.research: Gather facts from docs or the web and cite sources
taskTypes.review: Read a diff and find bugs, rule breaks, or regressions
taskTypes.test: Write or run tests; reproduce a bug
taskTypes.brainstorm: Generate options and ideas; argue both sides
taskTypes.content: Write or edit site copy in the brand voice
taskTypes.design: Visual system, layout, color and type decisions

taskSkills._readme: Skills and plugin commands each task type should use. Repo skills are files in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and any agent can read them; plugin commands (/impeccable, /ponytail-*, /graphify) work only where that plugin is installed.
plan: /graphify query "<question>" to find the files involved
build: ponytail decision ladder (skip > reuse > standard library > new code)
/graphify query to locate existing code before writing new code
review: /impeccable audit when the diff touches UI
brainstorm: repo skill: grilling (argue against the idea)
design: repo skill: brand-system (LOCKED: wins over any impeccable suggestion)

agents.strengths: knows this repo and its skills

agents.role: Claude subagent: TinaCMS, data layer, deploy, SEO
agents.strengths: knows this repo and its ADRs

agents.role: Claude subagent: visual system and brand
agents.strengths: applies brand-system and pnw-tribal-art skills

agents.role: Claude subagent: IA, navigation, flows
agents.strengths: owns the locked site architecture

agents.role: Claude subagent: brand voice copy
agents.strengths: merges the three source sites' content

agents.role: OpenAI Codex, read-only: independent second-opinion reviewer
agents.strengths: different model family from Claude, so it catches different mistakes; strong at code review and bug finding

agents.role: OpenAI Codex, can edit files: parallel implementer (run it inside a git worktree)
agents.strengths: fast, strong at self-contained coding tasks with clear acceptance tests

agents.role: Nous Research Hermes Agent: web researcher (runs under its own 'aiteam' profile)
agents.strengths: web research with citations; can run on a free local model; shares this repo's skills via skills.external_dirs

agents.role: OpenClaw 2.0: local-first agent platform; headless via `agent exec`
agents.strengths: runs fully on local Ollama models; browses sites, automates chores, good second brainstormer

args: Read the task in the file {promptFile} and complete it. Do not commit.
agents.role: OpenCode: open-source Claude-Code-style coder that runs any model, including local ones
agents.strengths: lets the free local models edit files like a real agent; JEV-gateway supports it

agents.role: Aider: git-native pair programmer, any model
agents.strengths: precise multi-file edits with a clean diff; strong with local Qwen coders
agents.install: python -m pip install aider-install  then  aider-install

agents.role: Alibaba Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B, tool-use agent (~24 GB, fast: 3B active)
